description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'CandidateHistorySearchFilterParams' for filtering candidate history search parameters within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes properties such as candidate ID and action IDs, and extends a base FilterParams class.

classes.name: CandidateHistorySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering candidate history search results, including sort configuration and specific filter properties like candidate ID and action IDs.

methods.name: getCandidateId
methods.description: Returns the candidate ID associated with the filter parameters.

methods.name: setCandidateId
methods.description: Sets the candidate ID for the filter parameters.

methods.name: getActionIds
methods.description: Retrieves the array of action IDs used as filters.

methods.name: setActionIds
methods.description: Sets the array of action IDs for the filter.
